home and daily routine.en: I get up at seven o'clock.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu me levanto às sete horas.

home and daily routine.text: Je prends une douche le matin.
home and daily routine.en: I take a shower in the morning.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu tomo banho de manhã.

home and daily routine.text: Je bois un café avec du lait.
home and daily routine.en: I drink a coffee with milk.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu tomo um café com leite.

home and daily routine.text: Mon appartement a trois pièces.
home and daily routine.en: My flat has three rooms.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu apartamento tem três cômodos.

home and daily routine.text: La cuisine est petite.
home and daily routine.en: The kitchen is small.
home and daily routine.pt: A cozinha é pequena.

home and daily routine.text: Je me brosse les dents.
home and daily routine.en: I brush my teeth.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu escovo os dentes.

home and daily routine.text: Je m'habille vite.
home and daily routine.en: I get dressed quickly.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu me visto rápido.

home and daily routine.text: Les enfants partent à l'école à huit heures.
home and daily routine.en: The children leave for school at eight.
home and daily routine.pt: As crianças saem para a escola às oito horas.

home and daily routine.text: Je fais la vaisselle après le dîner.
home and daily routine.en: I do the dishes after dinner.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu lavo a louça depois do jantar.

home and daily routine.text: Mon mari fait les courses.
home and daily routine.en: My husband does the shopping.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu marido faz as compras.

home and daily routine.text: Nous dînons à vingt heures.
home and daily routine.en: We have dinner at eight p.m.
home and daily routine.pt: Nós jantamos às vinte horas.

home and daily routine.text: Je me couche à onze heures.
home and daily routine.en: I go to bed at eleven.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu me deito às onze horas.

home and daily routine.text: La salle de bains est en haut.
home and daily routine.en: The bathroom is upstairs.
home and daily routine.pt: O banheiro fica no andar de cima.

home and daily routine.text: J'habite dans une maison avec jardin.
home and daily routine.en: I live in a house with a garden.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu moro em uma casa com jardim.

home and daily routine.text: Le salon est grand et clair.
home and daily routine.en: The living room is big and bright.
home and daily routine.pt: A sala é grande e clara.

home and daily routine.text: Je range ma chambre.
home and daily routine.en: I'm tidying my room.
home and daily routine.pt: Estou arrumando o meu quarto.

home and daily routine.text: Le chat dort sur le canapé.
home and daily routine.en: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.
home and daily routine.pt: O gato está dormindo no sofá.

home and daily routine.text: Je travaille de huit heures à seize heures.
home and daily routine.en: I work from eight to four.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu trabalho das oito às dezesseis horas.

home and daily routine.text: Le soir, je prépare le repas.
home and daily routine.en: In the evening, I make the meal.
home and daily routine.pt: À noite, eu preparo a refeição.

home and daily routine.text: Où sont mes clés ?
home and daily routine.en: Where are my keys?
home and daily routine.pt: Onde estão as minhas chaves?

home and daily routine.text: Je fais le ménage le samedi.
home and daily routine.en: I do the housework on Saturdays.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu faço faxina aos sábados.

home and daily routine.text: Ma chambre donne sur la rue.
home and daily routine.en: My bedroom looks onto the street.
home and daily routine.pt: Meu quarto dá para a rua.

home and daily routine.text: Je mets la table.
home and daily routine.en: I'm setting the table.
home and daily routine.pt: Estou pondo a mesa.

home and daily routine.text: Il y a un lit et une armoire.
home and daily routine.en: There is a bed and a wardrobe.
home and daily routine.pt: Tem uma cama e um guarda-roupa.

home and daily routine.text: J'arrose les plantes le matin.
home and daily routine.en: I water the plants in the morning.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu rego as plantas de manhã.

home and daily routine.text: Le frigo est vide !
home and daily routine.en: The fridge is empty!
home and daily routine.pt: A geladeira está vazia!

home and daily routine.text: Je lave mes vêtements le dimanche.
home and daily routine.en: I wash my clothes on Sundays.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu lavo as minhas roupas aos domingos.

home and daily routine.text: Je promène le chien le soir.
home and daily routine.en: I walk the dog in the evening.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu passeio com o cachorro à noite.

home and daily routine.text: Ma maison est près du centre.
home and daily routine.en: My house is near the centre.
home and daily routine.pt: Minha casa fica perto do centro.

home and daily routine.text: Je prends mon petit déjeuner à la maison.
home and daily routine.en: I have breakfast at home.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu tomo o café da manhã em casa.

home and daily routine.text: Ferme la fenêtre, s'il te plaît.
home and daily routine.en: Close the window, please.
home and daily routine.pt: Feche a janela, por favor.

home and daily routine.text: J'ouvre les volets.
home and daily routine.en: I open the shutters.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu abro as persianas.

home and daily routine.text: Je rentre chez moi à pied.
home and daily routine.en: I walk home.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu volto para casa a pé.

home and daily routine.text: Nous habitons au troisième étage.
home and daily routine.en: We live on the third floor.
home and daily routine.pt: Nós moramos no terceiro andar.

home and daily routine.text: Il n'y a pas d'ascenseur.
home and daily routine.en: There is no lift.
home and daily routine.pt: Não tem elevador.

home and daily routine.text: Je fais mon lit tous les matins.
home and daily routine.en: I make my bed every morning.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu arrumo a minha cama todas as manhãs.

home and daily routine.text: Le réveil sonne à six heures.
home and daily routine.en: The alarm goes off at six.
home and daily routine.pt: O despertador toca às seis horas.

home and daily routine.text: Je lis avant de dormir.
home and daily routine.en: I read before going to sleep.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu leio antes de dormir.

home and daily routine.text: La lampe est sur le bureau.
home and daily routine.en: The lamp is on the desk.
home and daily routine.pt: A luminária está em cima da escrivaninha.

home and daily routine.text: Je sors la poubelle le mardi.
home and daily routine.en: I take out the rubbish on Tuesdays.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu levo o lixo para fora às terças.

feelings and opinions.pt: Ela está triste hoje à noite.

feelings and opinions.text: Je pense que c'est une bonne idée.
feelings and opinions.en: I think it's a good idea.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu acho que é uma boa ideia.

feelings and opinions.text: Non, je ne suis pas d'accord.
Il est en colère contre son frère.
feelings and opinions.pt: Ele está bravo com o irmão.

feelings and opinions.text: Je préfère le thé au café.
À mon avis, c'est trop difficile.
feelings and opinions.en: In my opinion, it's too difficult.
feelings and opinions.pt: Na minha opinião, é difícil demais.

feelings and opinions.text: Léa est fière de son fils.
feelings and opinions.en: Léa is proud of her son.
feelings and opinions.pt: A Léa tem orgulho do filho.

feelings and opinions.text: Ils sont inquiets pour leur fille.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eles estão preocupados com a filha.

feelings and opinions.text: J'ai hâte de partir en vacances.
feelings and opinions.en: I can't wait to go on holiday.
feelings and opinions.pt: Mal posso esperar para sair de férias.

feelings and opinions.text: Tu penses quoi de mon idée ?
feelings and opinions.en: What do you think of my idea?
feelings and opinions.pt: O que você acha da minha ideia?

small talk with a neighbour.en: Very well, thank you, and you?
Yes, I live on the fourth floor.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Sim, eu moro no quarto andar.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il s'appelle Max, il a trois ans.
small talk with a neighbour.en: His name is Max, he's three.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Ele se chama Max, tem três anos.
Você mora aqui há muito tempo?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Depuis cinq ans, avec ma famille.
small talk with a neighbour.en: For five years, with my family.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Há cinco anos, com a minha família.

small talk with a neighbour.en: Have a nice day, Mr Bernard!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Tenha um bom dia, seu Bernard!

small talk with a neighbour.en: Are you going to the market?
My name is Antoine, and yours?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Eu me chamo Antoine, e você?
Quer que eu leve a sua sacola?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le facteur passe à onze heures.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O carteiro passa às onze horas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il y a une fête dans l'immeuble samedi.
small talk with a neighbour.en: There's a party in the building on Saturday.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Tem uma festa no prédio no sábado.

small talk with a neighbour.en: Are you coming to the party?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Les roses de votre balcon sont belles.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The roses on your balcony are beautiful.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: As rosas da sua varanda são lindas.

small talk with a neighbour.en: Are you going on holiday soon?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você vai sair de férias logo?
Sim, nós vamos para a Espanha.
O elevador está quebrado de novo.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous travaillez toujours à la mairie ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you still work at the town hall?

small talk with a neighbour.pt: A gente se vê amanhã, então.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Nos enfants sont dans la même classe.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Our children are in the same class.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Nossos filhos estão na mesma turma.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Votre chat est dans mon jardin !
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your cat is in my garden!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Seu gato está no meu jardim!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez l'heure, s'il vous plaît ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you have the time, please?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Je vous présente mon fils, Noah.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Este é o meu filho, Noah.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vous avez un peu de sel, s'il vous plaît ?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you have some salt, please?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Você tem um pouco de sal, por favor?

small talk with a neighbour.en: Have a good evening and see you soon!

small talk with a neighbour.text: Il y a beaucoup de bruit ce soir.
small talk with a neighbour.en: There's a lot of noise tonight.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Tem muito barulho hoje à noite.

phone calls and appointments.text: Je voudrais parler à Monsieur Petit.
phone calls and appointments.en: I would like to speak to Mr Petit.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu queria falar com o senhor Petit.

phone calls and appointments.text: Ne quittez pas, s'il vous plaît.
C'est de la part de qui ?

phone calls and appointments.en: I would like to make an appointment.

phone calls and appointments.pt: Terça de manhã está bom para você?

phone calls and appointments.text: Quel est votre numéro de téléphone ?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Qual é o seu número de telefone?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je ne vous entends pas bien.
Je vous rappelle dans cinq minutes.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll call you back in five minutes.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu ligo de volta para você em cinco minutos.

phone calls and appointments.en: Would you like to leave a message?

phone calls and appointments.text: Mon rendez-vous est jeudi à seize heures.
phone calls and appointments.en: My appointment is on Thursday at four p.m.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Minha consulta é na quinta às dezesseis horas.

phone calls and appointments.en: I have to cancel my appointment.

phone calls and appointments.text: Mon téléphone n'a plus de batterie.
phone calls and appointments.en: My phone has no battery left.

phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu te ligo hoje à noite.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le secrétariat répond de neuf heures à midi.
phone calls and appointments.en: The front desk answers from nine to twelve.
phone calls and appointments.pt: A secretaria atende das nove ao meio-dia.
É possível na sexta à tarde?

phone calls and appointments.text: Vous avez un rendez-vous plus tôt ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Do you have an earlier appointment?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você tem um horário mais cedo?

phone calls and appointments.text: Je suis en retard de dix minutes.
Je cherche le numéro de la mairie.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm looking for the town hall's number.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou procurando o número da prefeitura.

phone calls and appointments.en: Can you call me tomorrow morning?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Você pode me ligar amanhã de manhã?

phone calls and appointments.text: Parlez plus fort, s'il vous plaît.
Je note la date et l'heure.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm writing down the date and time.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou anotando a data e a hora.

phone calls and appointments.text: On se retrouve devant le cinéma ?
phone calls and appointments.en: Shall we meet in front of the cinema?
phone calls and appointments.pt: A gente se encontra na frente do cinema?

phone calls and appointments.text: D'accord, à huit heures et quart.
phone calls and appointments.en: Okay, at a quarter past eight.

phone calls and appointments.text: Merci de votre appel, bonne journée.
phone calls and appointments.en: Thank you for your call, have a nice day.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Obrigado pela ligação, tenha um bom dia.
